prompt: Create a PRODUCTION PIXEL-ART SWIMMING ANIMATION STRIP of exactly THREE full-body frames, 3 columns, 1 row, same-sized cells. Wide 3:1 image. Flat pure magenta #ff00ff background, including gaps. Reference image identifies the exact character and chunky low-resolution style: preserve face, colors, outfit, species, equipment and proportions. All THREE characters face RIGHT and have the SAME scale and stable head registration. This is an active SWIMMING STROKE, not flying, hovering, running or three almost-duplicate poses. The limb silhouettes must be VERY DIFFERENT in each frame, with at least a whole forearm-length of hand travel and obvious gathering/kicking of legs. Draw three successive stages REACH, PULL, RECOVERY so a 1-2-3 loop shows muscular propulsion. Torso leans forward substantially and legs trail behind; no feet planted under upright hips. Keep the anatomy human/animal as appropriate, no backwards knees. Put full creature centered within each cell, leaving wide clear margins. Preserve large flat pixel clusters, don't add small details. NO text, cell borders, water, ripples, splashes, bubbles, ground, shadows, motion lines, detached effects or extra characters. Large muscular blue frost giant with white beard/fur collar, ice crown and spikes, leather belt. SWIM side-on facing RIGHT. CELL 1 REACH: torso nearly horizontal, both massive hands stretched FAR FORWARD to the RIGHT of head, legs extended LEFT behind. CELL 2 PULL: elbows open and huge hands sweep DOWN far below the chest, knees start bending and feet spread. CELL 3 RECOVER: both hands gathered UNDER CHIN with elbows bent, BOTH knees bent toward belly and feet LEFT/UP ready to kick. Three profoundly different arm and leg silhouettes while face/head stays the same. Show the effort of hauling a huge body through water, not a flying superhero.
